simulation: not evaluable: generated variables are functions of measured series; the adapter has no generative simulation of y
replayRoundTrip: replayed series identical to the source (reading offset 0)

configuration.suppliedByDatasetMetadata: sampling regime, apparatus, uncertainty, missingness, units (V)
configuration.suppliedByResearcher: channel ids u and y, readout form, mutation registry variant, rounds (3), train/test boundary

predictionInformation: ŷ(t) from u(t−1), y(t−1) and generated variables at t−1 (the current input u(t) is not used)
protocolInterpretation: the adapter has no validation-selected hyperparameters, so the final fit uses all 1024 estimation rows (trainUntil = 1024); test rows are never used for selection
